_approach: A genuine UK garage 2-step kick placement (on the 1 and the "and" of a later beat, never a plain 4x4) crossed with the bass house clap/offbeat-hat frame — distinct from bh_ukg_skip, where the kick stays full 4x4 and only the hats skip. Here the kick itself skips, with rim ghosts filling the gaps the missing beats leave behind. Ref: The Producer School's UK garage production guide (canonical 2-step kick placement), Native Instruments' feature on Cloverdale balancing UKG swing against a bass house frame. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
